13.2.2.3.1 Dcm Service Use Case: read/write current values by BswModuleEntrys Scenario: a Basic Software Module offers a BswModuleEntrys to read/write current value via diagnostic services.
[TPS_BSWMDT_04121] Basic Software Module offers BswModuleEntrys to read/write current value via diagnostic services ⌈ ServiceNeeds kind DiagnosticValueNeeds RoleBasedBswModuleEntryAssignment valid roles:
• Xxx_ReadData [0..1] (1 in case read is supported)
• Xxx_WriteData [0..1] (1 in case write is supported)
• Xxx_ReadDataLength [0..1] (1 in case of variable length)
• Xxx_ConditionCheckRead [0..1] ](1 in case the read condition is provided by the BSW module) RoleBasedDataAssignment N/A RoleBasedDataTypeAssignment N/A
⌋()
